title: A Birthday Invitation
text:
Tom has a birthday party on Saturday. He wants to invite his friends. He writes invitation cards and gives them to his classmates at school. The party starts at 2 o'clock in the afternoon.

Anna gets an invitation from Tom. She is very happy. She says yes and buys a small gift. She will go to the party with her brother.

questions.text: What can we guess about Tom?
options: He wants his friends to come
He lives far away from school
He does not have any friends

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about the party?

vocabulary.definition: a card or message that asks someone to come to an event
the day each year when a person was born, often celebrated with a party
something that you give to someone, often on a special day
students who are in the same class at school

paragraph_translations: Tom'un cumartesi günü doğum günü partisi var. Arkadaşlarını davet etmek istiyor. Okulda sınıf arkadaşlarına davetiye kartları yazıyor ve veriyor. Parti öğleden sonra saat 2'de başlıyor.
Anna, Tom'dan bir davetiye alıyor. Çok mutlu. Evet diyor ve küçük bir hediye alıyor. Partiye kardeşiyle birlikte gidecek.
